This may only occur once per cast ability.@@description2@@'''Active:''' '''Zed''' creates a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' that dashes to the target location and remains there for 5.25 seconds, being able to mimic ''[[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]]'' and ''[[File:Zed Shadow Slash.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Shadow Slash|An icon for Zed's ability Shadow Slash]] [[Zed#Shadow Slash|Shadow Slash]]'' regardless of range. ''Living Shadow'' can be recast while within range of the ''Shadow''.@@description3@@'''Recast - Shadow Swap:''' '''Zed''' and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blink]] to swap places.@@description4@@''If an ability is cast while the Shadow is dashing, it will cast that ability once it has been placed. See [[Zed#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Shadows.''@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@

@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@2000 • Global@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@2500@@casttime@@none@@cost@@40 / 35 / 30 / 25 / 20@@cooldown@@20 / 19 / 18 / 17 / 16@@targeting@@[[Location-targeted|Location]] • [[Auto-targeted|Auto]]@@damagetype@@@@spellshield@@@@projectile@@@@notes@@ * '''Zed''' gains a buff for 5.25 seconds that indicates and determines the duration in which he may recast ''Living Shadow''. ** The buff is granted briefly after ''Living Shadow'' is cast. *** If cast at minimum distance, the buff and the ''Shadow's'' individual durations will effectively start at the same time. *** If cast at greater than the minimum distance, then the buff's duration will start before the ''Shadow's'' duration. * The passive is available while the ability has not been learned. It will grant the [[File:Energy icon.svg|15px|link=Energy]] energy refund strength at rank 1. * The [[File:Energy icon.svg|15px|link=Energy]] energy refund is not granted if the mimicked ability is blocked by a [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]]. * ''Living Shadow's'' recast can be queued to cast while the ''Shadow'' is dashing; the recast will occur once it has been placed. * ''Living Shadow'' cannot be recast while [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounded]] or [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooted]]. * If ''Living Shadow'' is recast during [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken's]] cast, '''Zed''' will instantly release the shuriken from the cast location of [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]] while still remaining in cast time. Once he has swapped places, he will then throw the shuriken that the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' would have thrown instead. ** '''Zed''' will cast [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]] as he normally would from the new location, but over the remaining cast time and towards the same point of cast. ** The [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' will not throw a shuriken from its new location, but will continue to play the cast animation for [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]]. ** This special interaction does not occur with the swap recast of [[File:Zed Death Mark 2.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Death Mark 2|An icon for Zed's ability Death Mark 2]] [[Zed#Death Mark 2|Death Mark]]; the recast will be buffered if used during [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken's]] cast. * '''Zed''' will swap places with the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' by all means if he buffers ''Living Shadow's'' recast during its dash.(unexpected) ** ''Living Shadow'' cannot be recast while '''Zed''' is marking his target with [[File:Zed Death Mark.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Death Mark|An icon for Zed's ability Death Mark]] [[Zed#Death Mark|Death Mark]], but may still be recast if it was buffered.(bug) * If '''Zed''' casts ''Living Shadow'' while a non-''[[File:Zed Death Mark 2.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Death Mark 2|An icon for Zed's ability Death Mark 2]] [[Zed#Death Mark 2|Death Mark]] Shadow'' is already present, the previous ''Shadow'' will instantly disappear. * If a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' expires while in the cast time of [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]], the mimicked cast will be cancelled. * [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' will cast [[File:Zed Shadow Slash.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Shadow Slash|An icon for Zed's ability Shadow Slash]] [[Zed#Shadow Slash|Shadow Slash]] independently of being in [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken's]] cast time or not.(unexpected) * [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' spawned from ''Living Shadow'' may sometimes last for up to an additional 0.25 seconds.(bug) * [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' will not disappear when '''Zed''' dies.(bug)@@
